venue: Penn & Teller Theater · Rio Las Vegas
address: 3700 W Flamingo Rd, Las Vegas, NV 89103
chart_source: Kris-approved supplied seating chart; use this image directly and do not redraw or regenerate it

zones.label: Section 1
zones.description: Section 1 is part of the Sweet Spot / Our Pick group. Sections 1–6 keep you in the main seating blocks with a strong read on the stage and the visual details in the act.

zones.label: Section 2
zones.description: Section 2 is part of the Sweet Spot / Our Pick group. It sits close to the stage with a direct view across the performance area.

zones.label: Section 3
zones.description: Section 3 is part of the Sweet Spot / Our Pick group. It keeps you close to the stage while preserving a broad view of the act.

zones.label: Section 4
zones.description: Section 4 is part of the Sweet Spot / Our Pick group. It gives you a strong view from the opposite half of the main seating bowl.

zones.label: Section 5
zones.description: Section 5 is part of the Sweet Spot / Our Pick group. It sits in the broad center-right block with an easy view of the full performance area.

zones.label: Section 6
zones.description: Section 6 is part of the Sweet Spot / Our Pick group. It keeps you in the main seating area with a clear stage view from the upper-right block.

zones.label: Section 7
zones.description: Section 7 sits farther from the stage and gives you a wider look across the room. It is a solid option when you prefer the full-stage picture over being close.

zones.label: Section 8
zones.description: Section 8 is farther back and off to the right, giving you a broad view of the stage from more distance.

zones.label: Section 9
zones.description: Section 9 sits in the upper-right block and gives you a wider overall perspective on the stage and room.

zones.label: AMP 1
zones.description: AMP 1 sits along the stage-side edge of the room. It puts you close to the performance area with a distinct side angle.

zones.label: AMP 2
zones.description: AMP 2 is a stage-side section with a close view toward the performance area and a more angled perspective than the main sections.

zones.label: AMP 3
zones.description: AMP 3 keeps the stage close while giving you a side-on view from the upper stage-side block.

zones.label: Booths
zones.description: The booths run through the center aisle between the main seating blocks. They offer a more separated seating setup with a clear angle toward the stage.
